Specifies the path under /amps/administrator/actions where this
action should appear. The action will run when a request for the
specified path is received by the AMPS admin interface.
For entitlement purposes, the AMPS admin interface treats actions
configured using this module identically to resources provided by
AMPS. That is, the user requesting that the action run must have
access to the appropriate admin resource for the action to run.
For example, to add an action that runs journal maintenance at the
path /amps/administrator/actions/journal_cleanup, you would use
the following Path element:
<Path>journal_cleanup</Path>
The Path element should contain only a resource name. No /
character should appear in the Path element.
